datasets.dataset_name: INFORMS Railway Applications Section (RAS) Track Geometry Telemetry
datasets.license: Open Academic & Research Use (INFORMS Problem Solving Competition)
datasets.measurement_units: Imperial / Metric standardized (Inches, Millimeters, MPH, Degrees Curvature)
datasets.description: 23,847 real geometry car defect records measuring Crosslevel, Surface Profile, Joint Foundation Dip, Train Speed, and Track Curvature.

datasets.dataset_name: Indian Railway Maintenance Prototype Benchmark (Quarantined Synthetic)
datasets.geographic_coverage: Simulated Indian Railways Zonal Track Sections
datasets.measurement_units: Normalized risk scores & arbitrary sensory integers
datasets.description: Synthetic maintenance dataset used to demonstrate post-hoc target leakage in academic benchmarks. Strictly isolated from production ML models.

datasets.dataset_name: Indian Railways Nationwide Station & Geographic Network
datasets.source_organization: OpenStreetMap, DataMeet Indian Railways, IR Official
datasets.license: Open Data Commons Open Database License (ODbL) / Open Data
datasets.description: 8,989 stations and 5,208 route LineStrings spanning the entire Indian Railways network.

datasets.dataset_name: Indian Railways 17 Zonal Railways & 69 Divisions Administrative Matrix
datasets.source_organization: Ministry of Railways Official Zonal Directories & Year Book
datasets.geographic_coverage: All 17 Zonal Railways and 69 Operating Divisions
datasets.measurement_units: Kilometers (Route Km, Running Track Km, Max Speed km/h)
datasets.validation_status: VALIDATED (67,440 route km, 122,286 running track km)
datasets.description: Official 17 zones and 69 operating divisions with headquarters, jurisdictions, route km, running track km, and maximum permissible speeds.

datasets.dataset_name: Indian Railways National Traffic, GMT Loading & Infrastructure Trends
datasets.source_organization: Ministry of Railways Year Book, MoSPI, Railway Board
datasets.measurement_units: Million Tonnes (Freight), Billion PKM (Passenger), Route Km, GMT
datasets.description: Annual freight originating tonnage (1,591 MT), passenger traffic, and zonal traffic density across 17 Zonal Railways.

datasets.dataset_name: Indian Railways Permanent Way Manual (IRPWM 2020) Statutory Standards
datasets.source_organization: Ministry of Railways, Railway Board, Government of India
datasets.description: 40 official threshold limits across Speed Bands Group A, B, C, D, and E for Gauge, Unevenness, Twist, and Alignment.

datasets.dataset_name: RDSO Ultrasonic Flaw Detection (USFD) & Rail Defect Taxonomy
datasets.source_organization: Research Designs and Standards Organisation (RDSO, Ministry of Railways)
datasets.measurement_units: Flaw Depth (mm), Echo Amplitude (dB), Testing Frequency (months), GMT
datasets.real_or_synthetic_status: REAL STATUTORY STANDARDS + CORRIDOR TELEMETRY SAMPLE
datasets.description: 16 USFD defect classification codes (100 to 800 series), IMR/OBS/REM urgency rules, GMT testing frequencies, and 250 realistic corridor inspection logs.

datasets.dataset_name: Indian Railways Track Infrastructure Engineering Specifications
datasets.measurement_units: kg/m, MPa, mm, Sleeper Density/km, km/h
datasets.description: 13 engineering specifications covering 60kg 90/110 UTS rails, PSC sleeper RT-2496, ballast cushion (250–350mm), and high-speed turnout geometries.

datasets.dataset_name: CAG & CRS Derailment Causation & 10-Year Consequential Accident Statistics
datasets.source_organization: Comptroller and Auditor General of India (CAG Report No. 22 of 2022) & MoR
datasets.measurement_units: Incident counts, Percent share, Fatalities, Injuries
datasets.description: 1,127 CAG investigated derailment causes (37.4% track causes), 6 detailed track failure subcauses, and 10 fiscal years of consequential train accident statistics.

datasets.source_organization: Open-Meteo Historical Weather Archive / Copernicus ECMWF Reanalysis v5
datasets.geographic_coverage: 8 Critical Indian Railway Zonal Hubs (NDLS, CNB, PRYJ, CSMT, HWH, MAS, NGP, GHY)
datasets.description: 14,616 daily weather records measuring max/min/mean ambient temperature, rainfall precipitation, wind speed, estimated rail temperature, buckling risk, and heatwaves.

datasets.dataset_name: Regional Climate Hazard & Flood Vulnerability Index
datasets.source_organization: Central Water Commission (CWC), NDMA & IR Monsoon Precautionary Orders
datasets.geographic_coverage: 12 Critical Vulnerable Indian Railway Operating Divisions
datasets.measurement_units: Vulnerability Index (0-10 scale), Qualitative Risk Flags
datasets.description: Climate vulnerability indices for flood-prone river crossings (Teesta, Kosi, Mithi), cyclone inundation, summer thermal buckling, and winter fog fracture zones.

datasets.source_organization: Academic Rail Defect Detection Benchmark (RTFD / Kaggle / GitHub)
datasets.description: 1,007 labeled real track photographs categorized into Defective (surface cracks, damaged sleepers, missing fasteners) and Non-Defective healthy tracks.

datasets.dataset_name: Indian Railways Broad Gauge TRC Corridor Telemetry Run
datasets.source_organization: Simulated Field Telemetry formatted to IR Track Recording Car (TRC) Standards
datasets.source_url: Internal CRIS / TMS RTI Template Format
datasets.geographic_coverage: New Delhi to Prayagraj Broad Gauge 130 km/h Corridor
datasets.description: 150-row realistic Indian Railways Broad Gauge TRC run verifying the automated RTI TMS ingestion pipeline.
